subject: city

city.own !== true || (self.knows('wars') && self.wars.some(p => !p.self && p.knows('major') && p.major === true && p.knows('name')))

(() => { const count = (units, name) => Object.hasOwn(units, name) ? Object.entries(units[name]).reduce((sum, [unit, n]) => Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 && !settlers.includes(unit) && !workers.includes(unit) && !missionaries.includes(unit) && !greatPeople.includes(unit) ? sum + n : sum, 0) : 0; const opponents = city.own ? self.wars.filter(p => p.knows('major') && p.major === true && p.knows('name')).map(p => p.name) : [city.owner.name]; return city.tacticalZones()?.some(zone => zone.knows('units') && count(zone.units, self.name) >= 2 && opponents.some(name => count(zone.units, name) >= 2)) ?? false; })()

values.contact: (() => { const count = (units, name) => Object.hasOwn(units, name) ? Object.entries(units[name]).reduce((sum, [unit, n]) => Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 && !settlers.includes(unit) && !workers.includes(unit) && !missionaries.includes(unit) && !greatPeople.includes(unit) ? sum + n : sum, 0) : 0; const opponents = city.own ? self.wars.filter(p => p.knows('major') && p.major === true && p.knows('name')).map(p => p.name) : [city.owner.name]; let best = null, largest = 0; for (const zone of city.tacticalZones() ?? []) { if (!zone.knows('units')) continue; const ours = count(zone.units, self.name); if (ours < 2) continue; for (const name of opponents) { const theirs = count(zone.units, name); if (theirs < 2 || ours + theirs <= largest) continue; largest = ours + theirs; best = { opponent: name, ourUnits: ours, theirUnits: theirs, domain: zone.domain, posture: zone.knows('posture') ? zone.posture : null }; } } return JSON.stringify(best); })()
